# 1b Template UI, versions, import/export: contract

**Read first:** [template authoring](../processes/servers/template-authoring.md) (everything except "handing the draft to an agent"), [ui/README → Servers](../ui/README.md#servers) (Templates list, Template page, editor), designs `RP-Templates`, `RP-Template`, `RP-Template-editor`, `RP-Template-publish`, the 1a contract and its **As built**.

**Done when:** the admin can create a template, edit its draft in the browser (file tree, editor, add/rename/delete/upload), save, validate with a per-file report, preview for the sample context, publish with notes (warnings confirmed), list and view versions, diff two versions, make a version the default, start a draft from an old version, discard the draft, export a version as a zip, import a zip or a git ref as a draft, archive/unarchive, and delete an unused template; every checklist line has its test.

Preview "for a chosen active server" is enabled in 1d, when servers exist; 1b builds the server picker against `store.ActiveServers` returning none.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Editor | **CodeMirror 6, vendored** (user decision 2026-10-07). Source in `web/editor/` (`package.json` with pinned versions, `editor.js` entry, `build.sh`); `make editor` runs esbuild in a `node:22-alpine` container (no Node on the host) and writes one minified ES module `internal/platform/ui/static/js/editor.bundle.js`, **committed**; CI checks it is fresh like `_templ.go` files (`make check` rebuilds and diffs). Contents: `@codemirror/view`, `state`, `commands`, `language`, `lint`, `search`, `lang-yaml`, `lang-json`, `legacy-modes` (shell, nginx), a Rosé Pine theme built from `tokens.css` variables. Language by file extension / name (`.yaml/.yml`, `.json`, `.sh`, `*.conf`/`*.conf.template` → nginx, `.env`/other → plain). The validation report feeds `@codemirror/lint` diagnostics (line → range) so markers show inline; a finding link selects the line. `Ctrl/Cmd+S` saves, `Tab` indents two spaces. CM6 styles through constructable stylesheets / CSSOM, not inline `<style>`: the strict CSP stays; if a browser needs `style-src` changes, record it in As built rather than loosening silently. Read-only views (version view, preview, diff) stay server-highlighted with `github.com/alecthomas/chroma/v2`. | User decision; one bundle keeps the no-build-step rule for everything else. |
| Editing model | The editor posts the **whole draft** (every file as a form field `file[<path>]`, plus `revision`) on Save. Add, Rename and Delete change the tree client-side and are saved with the next Save. Upload posts the file (or a zip, unpacked by the server with the import rules) together with the current form, and gets back the editor with the files added and the unsaved edits kept; nothing is saved until Save. Max request 12 MiB. | One save = one revision = one event. |
| Validation markers | The report panel lists findings per file (error/warning, check, line, message); a finding's line link selects that line in the editor (and the same findings are inline lint markers there), or anchors in read-only views. | ui/README. |
| Unsaved changes | `beforeunload` warning when the form is dirty. "The draft changed" (stale revision) → the page shows the band "The draft changed since you opened it" with **Reload** (loses local edits) and **Copy my version** (opens a read-only view of the posted files so nothing is lost). | Edge case "two tabs"; agent edits (1h) reuse it. |
| Preview | `POST /templates/:id/draft/preview` renders the **posted** files (unsaved edits included) for the sample context (or a server in 1d); generated values and secret parameters show as `•••` with **Reveal** per value only for a server (1d); sample values are shown plainly. | |
| Diff | `github.com/aymanbagabas/go-udiff` for unified diffs; a side-by-side view built from the same hunks. Binary files (non-UTF-8) show "binary, N bytes → M bytes". New platform component `ui.Diff`. | ui/README "plan / diff viewer". |
| Versions page | Number, published at, by, notes, warning count, servers built from it by lifecycle state (from `store`, zero in 1b), **View**, **Diff with…** (a select of other versions, default the previous), **Export**, **Make default**, **New draft from this version**. | |
| Make default | Strength 1. Records `template.default_version_changed{from, to}`. The same version → no event. | |
| New draft from a version | When a draft exists: strength 2 ("replaces the current draft"). `based_on` = that version, `source` = `{"kind":"version","version":N}`. Records `template.draft_saved{by: admin, files}`. | template-authoring.md "for reverting". |
| Discard draft | Strength 2. Deletes the draft (and in 1h closes an agent session with `discarded`). Records `template.draft_discarded` (new event, off). | |
| Export | `GET /templates/:id/versions/:n/export` → `application/zip`, name `<slug>-v<n>.zip`, entries `manifest.yaml` + files at the root, mode bits from the manifest in the zip headers, deterministic order and timestamps (the publish time). | Re-importing an export gives the same files. |
| Zip import | ≤ 12 MiB upload, ≤ 500 entries, ≤ 10 MiB uncompressed in total (stop reading past it: zip bomb), no symlinks, no absolute paths or `..`. `manifest.yaml` must be at the root or inside exactly one top-level folder (which is stripped); anything else → "manifest.yaml not found at the root". `__MACOSX/`, `.DS_Store`, `.git/` are skipped. Into a **new** template (name and slug from the form, defaulted from the manifest's `name`) or an **existing** one (strength 2 when it has a draft: "replaces the draft"). The draft's `source` = `{"kind":"zip","name":"<file name>"}`. | |
| Git import | `github.com/go-git/go-git/v5` in memory (`memory.NewStorage`, `memfs`), HTTPS URLs only, no credentials (public repositories), 60 s timeout, `Depth: 1`. The ref is a branch, tag or full 40-hex commit (`SingleBranch` + `ReferenceName` for branch/tag). A commit is the risky case: go-git speaks protocol v0/v1 and many hosts refuse an unadvertised SHA in a `want`, so try a shallow fetch of `+<sha>:refs/proxier/import` first and, when the server refuses it, fall back to a full in-memory clone of every branch (no depth) and check the commit out; both are bounded by the 60 s timeout and a 100 MiB transfer cap (a counting `http.Client` transport). Record in As built which path GitHub took. The path is a folder inside the repository; the same zip rules apply to its contents (size, entry count, nested `manifest.yaml` rule at the path). `source` = `{"kind":"git","url","ref","commit":"<resolved sha>","path"}`; the draft band shows it. Re-importing creates a new draft with the new commit. | template-authoring.md; the user's templates are on GitHub. |
| Archive | Strength 1; reversible (**Unarchive**). Hidden from the new-server form (1d) and from the list unless "show archived". Records `template.archived` / `template.unarchived`. | |
| Delete | Only when no server was ever built from any version (`servers_servers.template_id`, any state). Strength 3 (type the slug). Deletes template, draft and versions; records `template.deleted{slug}`. Otherwise refused with "Archive it instead" and the **Archive** button. | template-authoring.md rules. |
| Slug edit | Editable on the template page until a version exists; then shown read-only. | |
| Search | `Searcher` returns templates by name/slug; every template action is a `ui.Action` (palette). | 0b rules. |

## Go signatures

### `servers/templates` (additions)

```go
type Summary struct {
	ID              int64
	Slug, Name      string
	DefaultVersion  int
	Versions        int
	HasDraft        bool
	Archived        bool
	ServersByVersion map[int]map[string]int // version → lifecycle state → count
}
func (s *Service) List(ctx context.Context, showArchived bool) ([]Summary, error)
func (s *Service) Versions(ctx context.Context, templateID int64) ([]VersionInfo, error)
func (s *Service) MakeDefault(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, version int, actor string) error
func (s *Service) DraftFromVersion(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, version int, actor string) error
func (s *Service) DiscardDraft(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) Archive(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, archived bool, actor string) error
func (s *Service) Delete(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, actor string) error // ErrInUse
func (s *Service) Rename(ctx context.Context, templateID int64, name, slug, description, actor string) error // slug only before the first version

type FileDiff struct {
	Path    string
	Change  string // added removed changed unchanged
	Unified string // "" for unchanged
	Binary  bool
}
func Diff(a, b map[string][]byte) []FileDiff

func Export(v Version) ([]byte, error)                     // zip
func ReadZip(r io.ReaderAt, size int64) (map[string][]byte, error)
type GitSource struct{ URL, Ref, Path string }
func FetchGit(ctx context.Context, src GitSource) (files map[string][]byte, commit string, err error)
func (s *Service) Import(ctx context.Context, into ImportTarget, files map[string][]byte, src Source, actor string) (templateID int64, err error)

type ImportTarget struct {
	TemplateID int64  // 0: a new template
	Name, Slug string // for a new template
}
```

`FetchGit` takes an `http.Client` through a package variable or option so tests use an `httptest` git server (go-git's `transport/http` with a custom client; the test serves a bare repository with `git-http-backend`-free smart HTTP from go-git's own server package, or `file://` is **not** accepted in production but allowed by a test option).

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /templates` | List (name, default version, versions, servers per version, draft marker); filter "show archived"; **New template**, **Import…** |
| `POST /templates` | New template (name, slug, description) → editor |
| `GET /templates/:id` | Template page: header (name, slug, description, archived), draft band (based on, updated, source), versions table, actions |
| `POST /templates/:id` | Edit name/description (slug before the first version) |
| `GET /templates/:id/edit` | Editor (creates the draft from the latest version if none) |
| `POST /templates/:id/draft` | Save (all files + revision) |
| `POST /templates/:id/draft/upload` | Add a file or unpack a zip into the posted tree → tree fragment |
| `POST /templates/:id/draft/validate` | Report fragment (validates the **saved** draft; the editor saves first if dirty) |
| `POST /templates/:id/draft/preview` | Rendered files fragment |
| `GET /templates/:id/publish` | Publish screen: report, warnings, notes field |
| `POST /templates/:id/publish` | Publish (revision, notes, confirm_warnings) → template page |
| `POST /templates/:id/draft/discard` | Strength 2 |
| `GET /templates/:id/versions/:n` | Read-only view (tree + highlighted files) |
| `GET /templates/:id/diff?a=1&b=2&view=unified|split` | Diff |
| `POST /templates/:id/versions/:n/default` | Make default |
| `POST /templates/:id/versions/:n/draft` | New draft from this version |
| `GET /templates/:id/versions/:n/export` | Zip |
| `GET /templates/import` | Import form: zip upload or git (URL, ref, path); target new/existing |
| `POST /templates/import` | Import → editor of the resulting draft |
| `POST /templates/:id/archive`, `/unarchive`, `/delete` | as above |

Nav: Templates (`g t`). The template page's `?` sheet lists the editor keys.

## Events

New: `template.draft_discarded` (off). Uses `template.created`, `template.draft_saved`, `template.draft_validated`, `template.version_published`, `template.default_version_changed`, `template.archived`, `template.unarchived`, `template.deleted` from 1a.

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/processes/servers/template-authoring.md`: the editor is a vendored CodeMirror 6 bundle with inline validation markers; git import is public HTTPS only and fetches with git over HTTPS (not "the ref's archive"), with the full-clone fallback for a commit; zip limits.
- `CLAUDE.md` Commands: `make editor` (rebuild the CodeMirror bundle in Docker).
- `docs/events.md`: `template.draft_discarded`.
- `docs/ui/README.md#servers`: the editor's "the draft changed" band and **Copy my version**.

## Checklist

In `internal/modules/servers/templates/`:

- [ ] Diff: added, removed, changed, unchanged, binary — `diff_test.go` `TestDiffFiles`
- [ ] Export then import gives the same files and modes — `zipio_test.go` `TestExportImportRoundTrip`
- [ ] Zip with `manifest.yaml` nested two folders deep → "manifest.yaml not found at the root" — `zipio_test.go` `TestZipManifestTooDeep`
- [ ] Zip with one top-level folder → folder stripped — `zipio_test.go` `TestZipSingleFolderIsStripped`
- [ ] Zip with `..`, an absolute path or a symlink → refused; over 10 MiB uncompressed → refused without reading it all — `zipio_test.go` `TestZipIsSafe`
- [ ] Git import at a commit SHA → the draft records that SHA; re-importing a branch later → a new draft with the new commit — `gitimport_test.go` `TestGitImportRecordsCommit`
- [ ] Git import of a path without `manifest.yaml` → refused — `gitimport_test.go` `TestGitImportNeedsManifest`
- [ ] A server that refuses a SHA `want` → the full-clone fallback finds the commit; over the transfer cap → refused — `gitimport_test.go` `TestGitImportCommitFallback`
- [ ] Make default records the change once; the same version records nothing — `versions_test.go` `TestMakeDefault`
- [ ] New draft from version 1 while v2 exists → draft based on 1; publishing makes v3 — `versions_test.go` `TestDraftFromOldVersionPublishesNext`
- [ ] Delete a template whose v1 built a retired server → `ErrInUse` — `versions_test.go` `TestDeleteTemplateInUse`
- [ ] Delete an unused template removes versions and draft; `template.deleted` — `versions_test.go` `TestDeleteUnusedTemplate`
- [ ] Archive hides it from `List(false)`; unarchive brings it back; events — `versions_test.go` `TestArchive`
- [ ] Slug can't change after the first version — `versions_test.go` `TestSlugFrozenAfterPublish`

In `internal/modules/servers/pages/templates_test.go` (`sitetest`):

- [ ] New template → editor with the skeleton; save; validate shows per-file findings with line links — `TestEditorSaveAndValidate`
- [ ] Two tabs: the second save gets the "draft changed" band; nothing overwritten — `TestEditorStaleSave`
- [ ] Preview renders unsaved edits for the sample context — `TestPreviewUsesPostedFiles`
- [ ] Publish with errors shows the report, creates nothing; with warnings asks to confirm; then the template page shows v N+1 — `TestPublishFlow`
- [ ] Diff page renders unified and split for two versions — `TestDiffPage`
- [ ] Export downloads a zip named `<slug>-v<n>.zip` — `TestExportDownload`
- [ ] Import zip into a new template lands in its editor; into an existing one with a draft needs confirmation — `TestImportZipPages`
- [ ] Delete of a used template shows "Archive it instead" — `TestDeleteUsedTemplatePage`
- [ ] The committed editor bundle matches `make editor`'s output (in `make check`, not a Go test) — `Makefile` target `check-editor`
- [ ] Every page has no inline script/style (platform test covers new pages) — `TestPagesHaveNoInlineScriptOrStyle` (existing, must still pass)
